ONAY_YEDEK_UZERINE_YAZ:
The backup file '%s' already exists (size: %s, last modified: %s). Overwrite it?

The new backup is first written to a temporary file with the '.yarim' extension; if it finishes successfully it replaces the old one. If it fails, the old backup stays untouched.

ONAY_KULLANICI_SIL:
User '%s' will be deleted from the server.

This user will not be able to connect to any database. Privileges already granted (GRANT) stay behind without an owner. This cannot be undone.

Delete this user?
ONAY_YONETICI_YAP:
This user will be able to manage all users of the server.

Add the user as administrator?
ONAY_YONETICI_YAP_AD:
User '%s' will become an administrator. This user will be able to manage all users of the server.

Continue?
ONAY_PASIF_YAP:
User '%s' will be made inactive. This user will no longer be able to connect (the user is not deleted and can be made active again).

Continue?
ONAY_KAYITLI_SIFRE:
Update the saved connection password as well?

Yes: the saved (encrypted) password of this connection is replaced with the new password. The open connection is not affected.
